tool_args.rationale: The opposing-sign response to before/after input steps and variation with horizon are characteristic of the supplied normalized hysteresis law. Five diverse rows suffice for its three parameters (gain, relaxation time, equilibrium coefficient), so no paid probe is needed.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid rows already distinguish the documented before/after contrast law; the extra trajectory batch is specifically needed to identify the coupled memory ODE, which is not the indicated mechanism.

The pilot signature is opposing step shift and the observed rows set mem_conv and s_grad to zero; the documented normalized before/after contrast directly predicts dependence on u_now-u_past and H with three identifiable parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Static snapshot or static linear response
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Static snapshots were explicitly uninformative, and the opposing response across step directions rules out an H-independent function of u_now alone.
The target forecast horizon is 0.65, far below the documented reversal regime around H=15..25; the row pattern instead matches the before/after contrast mechanism.
